about: Story Mode Eras (ADR 0005, GLOSSARY: Era, Org Upgrade). DRAFT. Dates of Org Upgrades are when history makes them possible; 'basis' says why that date. Money values are multipliers on the game's 2026 economy.

eras.name: LAN Party
eras.summary: CS 1.0-1.5. Clans, LAN bags and IRC; prize money is the main income, and sponsors give hardware.
eras.summary_pt: CS 1.0–1.5. Clãs, LANs e IRC; prêmios são a principal renda, e patrocinadores pagam em hardware.

eras.name: 1.6 Golden Age
eras.summary: CS 1.6 on Steam. National leagues, the first salaries, gaming houses and the first big organizations.
eras.summary_pt: CS 1.6 no Steam. Ligas nacionais, os primeiros salários, gaming houses e as primeiras grandes organizações.

eras.name: Global Offensive
eras.summary: CS:GO arrives, streaming takes off, skins bring money in. The first million-dollar leagues.
eras.summary_pt: Chega o CS:GO, o streaming decola e as skins trazem dinheiro. As primeiras ligas milionárias.

eras.name: Esports Boom
eras.summary: Million-dollar Majors, franchised leagues, buyouts, analysts and psychologists. Then the online years.
eras.summary_pt: Majors de um milhão, ligas franqueadas, multas rescisórias, analistas e psicólogos. Depois, os anos online.

eras.name: CS2
eras.summary: Source 2, MR12, the open circuit and Valve's rankings. Today's game.
eras.summary_pt: Source 2, MR12, circuito aberto e o ranking da Valve. O jogo de hoje.
